tools.name: Read
tools.description: Read text, code, and image files in the workspace.
tools.capability: Read file contents without modifying files

tools.name: List
tools.description: List directory structures and basic file information.
tools.capability: Browse directories without reading file contents

tools.name: Grep
tools.description: Run full-text and regular-expression searches across project files.

tools.name: Find
tools.description: Find project files by name and pattern.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description: Apply precise local edits to existing files.
tools.capability: Modify existing files and produce diffs

tools.name: Write
tools.description: Create new files or overwrite file contents.

tools.name: Shell
tools.description: Run terminal commands as the current operating-system user.

tools.name: Web Search
tools.description: Search the internet through Bing RSS without installation or an API key.
tools.capability: Send search terms and return titles, links, summaries, and dates without modifying web pages

tools.name: Browser Control
tools.description: Provide an isolated, controlled browser for navigation, inspection, and page interaction.
tools.scope: Isolated browser for the current primary Agent chat; HTTP/HTTPS only
tools.capability: Navigate, inspect, click, type, wait, capture screenshots, and close the browser without arbitrary JavaScript

tools.name: Visual Generate
tools.description: Generate or edit images, mockups, posters, logos, or videos.
tools.capability: Generate or edit images and videos

tools.name: Skill Create
tools.description: Create a standards-compliant Agent Skill in the current project or global Pisper skills directory.
tools.scope: Current project or global Pisper skills directory
tools.capability: Validate and atomically create a new SKILL.md without overwriting existing content

tools.name: Plugin Create
tools.description: Create and install a standards-compliant local Pisper plugin for all projects.
tools.scope: Global Pisper plugin sources and local plugin installation
tools.capability: Define one or more Agent tools, create their source without overwriting files, validate the plugin, and install it

tools.name: Mobile Device
tools.description: Use phone capabilities permitted by the connected Pisper mobile App and operating system, including device status, storage, clipboard, photos, sensors, and constrained external apps.
tools.scope: Currently connected Pisper mobile App and its per-capability privacy controls
tools.capability: Inspect or update supported phone state, organize photos, use sensors, and open approved external targets

tools.name: Typed Decide
tools.description: Ask a decision model typed questions (yes-no, choice, score) about a state and get typed answers and available probabilities.
tools.scope: Remote decision model configured in settings
tools.capability: Judge text or structured state with typed questions and return probabilities without generating text

tools.name: Image Assets
tools.description: Generate action frames, remove backgrounds locally, split, manually edit, and export image assets.
tools.scope: Imported workspace images and managed image assets
tools.capability: Use the same image-processing engine as workflows and the game assets workbench

tools.name: Memory Search
tools.description: Search long-term memory across global and current-project spaces.
tools.capability: Read relevant preferences, facts, decisions, and tasks without modifying memory

tools.name: Memory Remember
tools.description: Save explicit remember requests directly and silently queue inferred reusable information as candidates.
tools.capability: Save explicit requests, queue inferred candidates, and hide common secret formats

tools.name: MCP List
tools.description: Read configured MCP services, connection status, and available tools.
tools.capability: Read redacted MCP service information without changing configuration

tools.name: MCP Manage
tools.description: Manage MCP services with structured parameters. To add a service, use action="add" and put the complete connection in config: stdio requires name, transport="stdio", and command; http or sse requires name, transport, and url.
tools.capability: Modify MCP service configuration without exposing sensitive headers or environment values
